## Handling

Describe the maneuver, speed if known, stick input and response.
What felt different from the real aircraft?

## Visibility and scenery

Could you identify the airplane's orientation? Include distance if known,
screen resolution, auto-zoom setting (Z), and a screenshot when useful.

## Controller setup

How long did setup take? Were mapping, calibration and throttle arming clear?

## Evidence

Optional: flight trace (T), fixed-wing flight log (F10; F11 marks a maneuver),
frame-time report, screenshots or video. See docs/FLIGHT-LOGGING.md for replay.
